official_measurement_examples.name: DHRA April 2026 version
official_measurement_examples.fact: The Coal Development High Risk Area dataset was updated 14 April 2026 and represents recorded coal-mining features that can pose potential surface-stability or public-safety risks.

official_measurement_examples.name: High risk not failure certainty
official_measurement_examples.fact: Development High Risk Area status identifies recorded risk features and the need for assessment; it is not a probability statement that subsidence or collapse will occur at a parcel.

official_measurement_examples.name: CMRA requirement context
official_measurement_examples.fact: For most development in the Development High Risk Area a Coal Mining Risk Assessment is required, subject to exemptions and local planning authority confirmation.

official_measurement_examples.name: Low risk limitation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Development Low Risk Area status removes the statutory CMRA requirement in general but does not prove there are no unrecorded coal-mining hazards.

official_measurement_examples.name: Mine entry investigation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Where mine entries affect a proposal their exact location may require intrusive investigation and can influence layout or no-build zones; map proximity alone is not an exact engineering boundary.

official_measurement_examples.name: Report versus planning decision
official_measurement_examples.fact: A coal-mining search or report provides risk evidence and is not planning permission, engineering sign-off or proof of land ownership.

official_measurement_examples.name: Current authority identity
official_measurement_examples.fact: The Mining Remediation Authority is the operating name used since November 2024 while the Coal Authority remains the legal name pending legislation; provenance should retain this distinction.

official_measurement_examples.name: 2026 currentity and promotion guard
official_measurement_examples.fact: Planning advice was updated 25 June 2026 and the 2025-26 annual report was published 15 July 2026; no parcel coal-risk clearance or Future Growth score is promoted while recovery is parked.

core_rules: DHRA is recorded-risk screening not failure probability
DHRA is not automatic planning refusal
CMRA requirement retains exemptions and LPA confirmation
Development Low Risk Area is not proof of no unrecorded hazard
mine-entry map proximity is not exact intrusive survey location
mining report is not planning permission
mining report is not engineering sign-off
mining evidence is not land ownership
operating and legal authority names retain context
current dataset and advice dates retained
no promotion while recovery is parked
